title: kyc and wallet-connector routes state no authorization rule: /api/kyc/:id/document, /selfie, /complete, /result, /api/kyc/microsoft/*, GET and DELETE /api/wallets/session/:id
description:
**BLUF:** The authorization rule for these kyc and wallet-connector routes is not stated anywhere, and the code carries no visible check. QA gate 42 (on KS-1845) listed them; KS-1845 did not cover them. This ticket asks for a stated rule for each route, then a check that matches it.

## The routes (develop a41909b50b44)

| Route | Where |
| -- | -- |
| `POST /api/kyc/:id/document` | `services/kyc/src/index.ts:801` |
| `POST /api/kyc/:id/selfie` | `services/kyc/src/index.ts:924` |
| `POST /api/kyc/:id/complete` | `services/kyc/src/index.ts:992` |
| `GET /api/kyc/:id/result` | `services/kyc/src/index.ts:1115` |
| `/api/kyc/microsoft/*` | mounted at `services/kyc/src/index.ts:571` |
| `GET /api/wallets/session/:sessionId` | `services/wallet-connector/src/server.ts:154` |
| `DELETE /api/wallets/session/:sessionId` | `services/wallet-connector/src/server.ts:195` |

## How much was read (be exact about this)

* **The gate** read the bodies of the first three kyc routes only.
* **This ticket's author** grepped the first 25 lines of the four kyc handlers and the two wallet handlers for a read of the caller's user, a role check, an owner compare or a 403. There were 0 hits. That is a grep of the opening lines, not a reading of each whole body.
* `/api/kyc/microsoft/*` **was not read at all.**
* The gate notes that the mock auto-approve through `/complete` is not a production door IF `enforceProductionConfig` works as read (`index.ts:45`); that was not run.
* Nothing here was run against a stack or the gateway. No exploit is claimed.

## Board search before filing

Team KS issues, archived included, titles, descriptions and comments:

* `api/kyc/:id/complete` 0 hits; `kyc/:id/result` 0 hits.
* `kyc/:id/document` 2 hits, KS-849 (the mock timer) and KS-386 (image storage). `kyc/:id/selfie` 1 hit, KS-849. Neither is about authorization.
* `kyc/microsoft` 24 hits, mostly spec sweeps; KS-626 is the Entra callback. Titles read; none is a rule for these routes.
* `wallets/session/` 7 hits; KS-1360 is about a 200 body field. Titles read.
* KS-1703 (seven GET-by-id routes) was read and does not list these.
* Controls: `run-code-guards` gave hits (positive); a zero token generated at run time gave 0 (not recorded here).

## Not in scope

`GET /api/kyc/:id`, `GET /api/kyc/user/:userId`, `DELETE /api/kyc/user/:userId/data` and `POST /api/kyc/initiate` were reported separately from KS-1845 and are not listed here.
